Official.description: A race official or volunteer: marshal, medic, pacer or station crew. A first name alone is not an identity.

Runner.description: An entrant in the marathon, by the name on their bib.

Station.description: A fixed point on the course: an aid station or the finish area.

Posting.description: An official's place at a station: leading it, or staffing it under the lead.

Support.description: An official assigned to look after one runner: a pacer runs alongside, a medic watches their health.

Incident.description: Something that went wrong on the course. reported_by raised it, responder dealt with it, signed_off_by closed it; state is open, handled or escalated.

Supply.description: Goods sent to a station. delivered stays empty until a delivery is recorded.

messages.text: Folasade Adeyemi: I lead Harbour Bridge Station this year, and Henrik Aaltonen staffs it with me.

messages.text: Incident log: a fall at mile 9 is handled, reported by Ottilie Brandt and treated by Rafael Ibarra, with no ambulance needed.

messages.text: Henrik Aaltonen: Rafael Ibarra and Rafael Mendes both radioed in at noon. Rafael said he needs more ice.
Kaveh Rostami wrote that Folasade Adeyemi will be his pacer for the last ten miles. He also named Rafael Ibarra as his medic.

facts.in: I delivered 12 crates of water to Mill Lane Station this morning.

messages.text: Logistics: the gels for Finish Village have not been delivered yet.

facts.in: the gels for Finish Village have not been delivered yet.

messages.text: Rafael Mendes: I'm not Siobhan Gallagher's pacer any more. Henrik paces her now.

messages.text: Ottilie Brandt: I think the cramp at mile 22 could be escalated, maybe with Folasade responding.

messages.text: Radio relay from Henrik Aaltonen: "Thandiwe Mokoena is through the gate, I saw her myself." He sounded relieved.
quotes: Thandiwe Mokoena is through the gate, I saw her myself.

messages.text: I chalked "runners keep left" on the road and Eitan Shapiro thanked me.
Thandiwe Mokoena: If my knee holds up, Henrik Aaltonen will be my pacer after mile 20.

facts.in: Henrik Aaltonen will be my pacer after mile 20
facts.label: pacer

messages.text: The collapse at mile 25 was escalated with an ambulance called, reported by Henrik Aaltonen, treated by Rafael Mendes and signed off by Folasade Adeyemi, runner conscious throughout.

facts.in: The collapse at mile 25 was escalated

messages.text: Folasade Adeyemi: Ottilie, could you sign off the blister case at mile 14 and put me down as responder?

messages.text: Rafael Mendes: The radio crew keeps confusing me with the other Rafael. Rafael Ibarra is Eitan Shapiro's medic, not me.

facts.label: medic

facts.in: not me
facts.label: medic

messages.text: Hi crew, 30 crates of bananas reached Harbour Bridge Station at 7: all delivered. I signed for them. Thanks, Ottilie

facts.in: not Rafael Mendes
facts.label: leads

messages.text: Eitan Shapiro's twisted ankle at mile 17 was handled by Rafael Ibarra without an ambulance. Eitan finished walking.

facts.in: Eitan Shapiro's twisted ankle at mile 17 was handled by Rafael Ibarra without an ambulance.

messages.text: Siobhan Gallagher crossed the line in her club vest. A different Siobhan, the runner in bib 404, waved to her.
Minutes, Friday briefing: Rafael Mendes will staff Finish Village on race day. Ottilie Brandt becomes the pacer for Eitan Shapiro next year.

facts.in: Rafael Mendes will staff Finish Village on race day.
facts.label: staffs

facts.in: Ottilie Brandt becomes the pacer for Eitan Shapiro next year.

messages.text: Folasade Adeyemi: Ottilie Brandt reported a missing runner at mile 11, still open; Ottilie says she is searching the park.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Runner)-[:pacer]->(n1:Official) WHERE n0.bib_name = 'Kaveh Rostami' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: eitan
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Runner)-[:medic]->(n1:Official) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: henrik
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Official)-[:paced]->(n1:Runner) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.bib_name AS bib_name

questions.q: Who is the leader of Mill Lane Station?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Station)-[:leader]->(n1:Official) WHERE n0.label = 'Mill Lane Station' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: fola
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Official)-[:leads]->(n1:Station) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.label AS label

questions.q: Who are the staff at Finish Village?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Station)-[:staff]->(n1:Official) WHERE n0.label = 'Finish Village' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: At what mile was the collapse?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.what = 'collapse' RETURN n0.mile AS mile

questions.q: Which incidents did Ottilie Brandt report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Official)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Ottilie Brandt' RETURN n1.what AS what

questions.q: Which incidents did I sign off?
questions.speaker: fola
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Official)<-[:signed_off_by]-(n1:Incident) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.what AS what

questions.q: Is there a record of an ambulance for the twisted ankle?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.what = 'twisted ankle' RETURN coalesce(n0.ambulance, false) AS ambulance

questions.q: Was an ambulance called for the collapse?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.what = 'collapse' RETURN n0.ambulance AS ambulance

questions.q: Have the supplies for Finish Village been delivered?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Station)<-[:station]-(n1:Supply) WHERE n0.label = 'Finish Village' RETURN n1.delivered AS delivered

questions.q: What goods and how many crates went out in each supply?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Supply) RETURN n0.goods AS goods, n0.crates AS crates

questions.q: What is Henrik Aaltonen's radio call?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Official) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Henrik Aaltonen' RETURN n0.radio_call AS radio_call

questions.q: How many crates went to Harbour Bridge Station?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Station)<-[:station]-(n1:Supply) WHERE n0.label = 'Harbour Bridge Station' RETURN n1.crates AS crates
